sentences.text: The company operates in the Wires and Cables, FMEG, and EPC business sectors.

receipt.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum.

sentences.text: It serves customers through a distribution-led model, noting that channel sales grew faster than institutional sales.

receipt.quote: Channel sales also grew faster than institutional sales, underscoring the resilience and effectiveness of our distribution-led model.

sentences.text: The business is divided across different segments, with the FMEG segment registering the fastest growth.

receipt.quote: The FMEG segment delivered a breakthrough quarter, registering a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth with strong performance across all major product categories.

sentences.text: The company is investing in capacity expansion, supply chain capabilities, and future growth platforms.

receipt.quote: During the first half of the year, we incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion, reflecting our ongoing investments in capacity expansion, supply chain capabilities and future growth platforms.

sentences.text: Management says the performance underscores the resilience of its operating model and the strength of disciplined execution.

receipt.quote: This performance underscores the resilience of our operating model and the strength of disciplined execution across the organization.

segments.text: The Wires and Cables business continues to deliver robust growth supported by healthy demand trends.

receipt.quote: The Wires and Cables business continues to deliver robust growth, supported by healthy demand trends, strong market positioning, and consistent execution.

segments.name: Wires and Cables

segments.text: The FMEG segment continued to strengthen its growth trajectory and recorded profitable quarters.

receipt.quote: The FMEG segment continued to strengthen its growth trajectory and recorded its seventh consecutive profitable quarter.

segments.name: FMEG

segments.text: The EPC segment reported healthy year-on-year growth with strong segment profitability.

receipt.quote: The EPC segment reported revenues of INR 6,171 million in Q2 FY27, representing a healthy year-on-year growth of 53%.

segments.name: EPC
